Class Ir

java.lang.Object
mjvm.ir.Ir
public final class Ir extends Object
Flat stack-ish IR for compiled M (mJVM M1). Ops are intentionally few: straight-line SET/WRITE/arith is M2. DO/$$/GOTO via invokedynamic is M3 (CallDyn / GotoDyn stubs).
